description: Define `packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto` with a language-agnostic Graph envelope plus extensible `NodeKind` / `EdgeKind` enums, and reference it from both `go-code-graph` and (later) `typescript-code-graph`; never duplicate the envelope.

requirements.description: Define a single canonical proto schema at packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto containing a language-agnostic Graph envelope with extensible NodeKind and EdgeKind enums. This schema must be referenced by both go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph (and future language scenarios). The proto envelope must never be duplicated: all consumers import from this single source of truth. NodeKind must cover at minimum: PACKAGE, FILE, FUNCTION, METHOD, TYPE, INTERFACE, VAR, CONST. EdgeKind must cover at minimum: IMPORT, CALLS, REFERENCES, CONTAINS, IMPLEMENTS.
requirements.title: Shared Language-Agnostic Code-Graph Proto Envelope

validation.notes: Proto compilation test: code_graph.proto compiles without errors using protoc
Test that NodeKind enum contains all required kinds (PACKAGE, FILE, FUNCTION, METHOD, TYPE, INTERFACE, VAR, CONST) and is extensible via reserved ranges
Test that EdgeKind enum contains all required kinds (IMPORT, CALLS, REFERENCES, CONTAINS, IMPLEMENTS) and is extensible via reserved ranges
Test that Graph message fields include nodes, edges, warnings, and graph_hash at minimum
Verify no duplicate proto definitions exist across go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph by scanning the repository
go-code-graph Extract response deserializes correctly using the shared proto envelope
Proto schema import path packages/proto/schemas/common/v1/code_graph.proto resolves correctly in both go-code-graph and typescript-code-graph build graphs
Adding a new NodeKind variant to the shared proto does not break existing consumers (forward-compatibility test)
Architecture review confirms single proto file location with no duplication across language scenario packages
typescript-code-graph references the same code_graph.proto without copying or redefining the Graph envelope

title: Shared Code-Graph Proto Envelope
